verdicts.explanation: The abstract reports 5.7 × 10−4 S cm−1 at room temperature (300 K) from this paper's simulations, which the paper estimates via Nernst-Einstein with a Haven ratio of one. The 0.29 eV barrier is correctly left unassigned.

The introduction attributes 4.3 × 10−8 S cm−1 at 300 K and 0.66 eV to Delmas et al. [46], measured by impedance spectroscopy on 80%-dense samples, so literature_cited is correct and the 80% density is stated for that material.
Nomura and Greenblatt [47] are cited for 3.7 × 10−8 S cm−1 at room temperature and a 0.46 eV low-temperature barrier. The room-temperature value has no numeric temperature, so null is correct.
The introduction cites Nomura and Greenblatt [47] for 3.4 × 10−7 S cm−1 in Li7.4Ta0.6Zr0.4O6, with Zr as the dopant. No measurement temperature is given, so null is correct.
Mühle et al. [48] are cited for 1.53 × 10−7 S cm−1 at 50 °C by impedance spectroscopy, with 0.68 eV given for the 50–400 °C range that includes 50 °C. This is literature_cited, not this work.
The introduction states LGPS (ref. [31]) has 12 mS cm−1 at room temperature. This is a cited comparison value, so literature_cited is correct.

The introduction gives amorphous LiPON's room-temperature conductivity of 2.3 × 10−6 S cm−1 with a ~0.55 eV barrier, citing ref. [36]. The values are literature_cited and the temperature is correctly null.
